categories.name: Breakfast
categories.description: Traditional South Indian morning delights prepared with pure ghee and homemade chutneys.

categories.name: Lunch & Meals
categories.description: Royal Satvik meals and aromatic spice rice preparations served with authentic recipes.

categories.name: Worship Offerings (Naivedyam)
categories.description: Sacred food preparations dedicated to Lord Sri Venkateswara with deep spiritual reverence.

categories.name: Snacks
categories.description: Crispy, freshly fried tea-time treats and authentic savory bites.

categories.name: Desserts

categories.name: Drinks

menu_items.name: Idli
menu_items.description: Steamed fluffy rice and lentil cakes served with authentic coconut chutney, tomato chutney, and piping hot sambar.
menu_items.ingredients: Rice, Urad Dal, Fenugreek, Salt

menu_items.name: Ghee Idli
menu_items.description: Soft steamed idlis drenched in generous aromatic pure cow ghee and sprinkled with podi (gunpowder spice).
menu_items.ingredients: Rice, Urad Dal, Pure Cow Ghee, Gunpowder Podi

menu_items.name: Mini Idli
menu_items.description: Button mini idlis floating in a bowl of hot aromatic Tirupati special sambar topped with pure ghee.
menu_items.ingredients: Mini Steamed Idlis, Drumstick Sambar, Ghee

menu_items.name: Vada
menu_items.description: Golden crispy lentil donuts seasoned with black pepper, ginger, and curry leaves.
menu_items.ingredients: Urad Dal, Black Pepper, Ginger, Curry Leaves

menu_items.name: Medu Vada
menu_items.description: Classic crunchy Medu Vada served with fresh green coconut chutney and aromatic drumstick sambar.
menu_items.ingredients: Urad Dal, Green Chilies, Cumin, Pepper

menu_items.name: Pongal
menu_items.description: Comforting savory rice and moong dal porridge tempered with ghee, cumin, black pepper, and roasted cashews.
menu_items.ingredients: Raw Rice, Moong Dal, Pure Ghee, Cashews, Pepper, Cumin

menu_items.name: Ven Pongal
menu_items.description: Traditional temple style Ven Pongal made with pure ghee and crushed black pepper, served with coconut chutney.
menu_items.ingredients: Raw Rice, Yellow Moong Dal, Ghee, Cashews, Ginger

menu_items.name: Plain Dosa
menu_items.description: Thin, golden crisp fermented rice crepes served with sambar and trio of traditional chutneys.
menu_items.ingredients: Rice Batter, Urad Dal, Salt

menu_items.name: Masala Dosa
menu_items.description: Crispy golden crepe stuffed with aromatic spiced potato and onion masala, cooked on tawa.
menu_items.ingredients: Rice Crepe, Spiced Potato filling, Mustard seeds, Turmeric

menu_items.name: Mysore Masala Dosa
menu_items.description: Signature crispy dosa lined with fiery garlic-red chili paste and filled with tempered potato masala.
menu_items.ingredients: Dosa Batter, Spicy Red Chutney, Potato Masala, Butter

menu_items.name: Ghee Roast
menu_items.description: Super thin paper crisp dosa roasted extravagantly in pure deshi ghee until golden perfection.
menu_items.ingredients: Fermented Rice Batter, Pure Desi Ghee

menu_items.name: Rava Dosa
menu_items.description: Lacy, crispy golden semolina pancake infused with black pepper, cumin seeds, and finely chopped green chilies.
menu_items.ingredients: Semolina, Rice Flour, Cumin, Pepper, Green Chili

menu_items.name: Onion Dosa
menu_items.description: Crispy dosa topped generously with sweet caramelized shallots and chopped fresh coriander.
menu_items.ingredients: Rice Crepe, Chopped Onions, Coriander, Ghee

menu_items.name: Set Dosa
menu_items.description: Trio of soft, sponge-like fluffy dosas served with creamy vegetable kurma and coconut chutney.
menu_items.ingredients: Rice, Poha, Curd, Vegetable Gravy

menu_items.name: Uttapam
menu_items.description: Thick savory rice pancake topped with fresh tomatoes, onions, green chilies, and coriander.
menu_items.ingredients: Thick Dosa Batter, Onion, Tomato, Coriander

menu_items.name: Poori
menu_items.description: Piping hot deep fried puffed wheat bread served with spiced potato bhaji and onion coconut salad.
menu_items.ingredients: Whole Wheat Flour, Potato Gravy, Spices

menu_items.name: Chapati
menu_items.description: Soft whole wheat flatbread served with seasonal mixed vegetable curry and dal fry.
menu_items.ingredients: Atta (Whole Wheat Flour), Vegetable Curry

menu_items.name: Upma
menu_items.description: Traditional roasted semolina dish cooked with mustard seeds, curry leaves, roasted cashews, and veggies.
menu_items.ingredients: Roasted Rava, Mustard, Curry Leaves, Cashews, Carrots

menu_items.name: Kesari Bath
menu_items.description: Melt-in-mouth saffron infused semolina sweet pudding loaded with pure ghee, cashews, and raisins.
menu_items.ingredients: Semolina, Saffron, Sugar, Ghee, Cashews, Raisins

menu_items.name: Srivari Maha Bhojanam
menu_items.description: The ultimate royal temple feast served on a giant banana leaf with 18 sacred Satvik items and Tirupati Laddu.
menu_items.ingredients: Pulihora, Chakkara Pongal, Sambar Rice, Daddojanam, Laddu, Vada, Curry, Rasam, Payasam, Ghee
menu_items.worship_significance: Prepared following strict Tirumala temple Satvik culinary traditions without onion or garlic.

menu_items.name: South Indian Meals
menu_items.description: Authentic South Indian Bhojanam with steamed rice, drumstick sambar, rasam, kootu, poriyal, curd, ghee, papad, and sweet.
menu_items.ingredients: Steamed Rice, Sambar, Rasam, Poriyal, Avial, Curd, Ghee

menu_items.name: Deluxe Meals
menu_items.description: Lavish meals including Paneer butter masala, Chapati, Special Rice, Sambar, Rasam, Curd, Payasam, and Sweet Pan.
menu_items.ingredients: Special Rice, Chapati, Paneer Curry, Sambar, Rasam, Sweet

menu_items.name: Andhra Meals
menu_items.description: Spicy authentic Andhra Bhojanam served with Gunpowder Podi, Nethi Ghee, Majjiga Pulusu, Vepudu, Gongura Pachadi.
menu_items.ingredients: Rice, Gongura Chutney, Podi, Ghee, Fry, Majjiga Pulusu

menu_items.name: Vegetable Biryani
menu_items.description: Long grain basmati rice slow cooked with garden fresh vegetables, saffron, and aromatic biryani spices in a handi.
menu_items.ingredients: Basmati Rice, Carrots, Beans, Peas, Biryani Masala, Saffron

menu_items.name: Paneer Biryani
menu_items.description: Fragrant Dum Biryani studded with golden marinated cottage cheese cubes and fresh mint leaves.
menu_items.ingredients: Paneer Cubes, Basmati Rice, Mint, Saffron, Ghee

menu_items.name: Curd Rice
menu_items.description: Cooling creamy yogurt rice tempered with mustard seeds, curry leaves, ginger, pomegranate, and grapes.
menu_items.ingredients: Steamed Rice, Fresh Yogurt, Milk, Mustard, Pomegranate

menu_items.name: Tirupati Laddu
menu_items.description: The world-famous sacred Srivari Laddu Prasadam enriched with pure deshi ghee, gram flour, sugar candy, cashew nuts, raisins, cardamom, and edible camphor (Pachcha Karpooram).
menu_items.ingredients: Gram Flour (Besan), Pure Cow Ghee, Sugar Candy, Cashews, Raisins, Edible Camphor, Cardamom
menu_items.worship_significance: Primary Naivedyam offered to Lord Sri Venkateswara Swami at Tirumala. It brings divine blessings, harmony, and spiritual bliss to those who partake.

menu_items.name: Pulihora
menu_items.description: Sacred divine tamarind rice seasoned with turmeric, green chilies, mustard seeds, curry leaves, and roasted peanuts.
menu_items.ingredients: Raw Rice, Tamarind Paste, Turmeric, Mustard Seeds, Curry Leaves, Peanuts
menu_items.worship_significance: Symbolizes the preservation of health and wisdom; tamarind and turmeric represent divine protection and purity in Vaishnava traditions.

menu_items.name: Chakkara Pongal
menu_items.description: Rich jaggery and rice pudding simmered with milk, pure ghee, crushed cardamom, and ghee-fried cashews.
menu_items.ingredients: Raw Rice, Yellow Moong Dal, Organic Jaggery, Cow Ghee, Cashew Nuts, Cardamom
menu_items.worship_significance: Offered to Lord Vishnu during morning poojas. Sweet jaggery and ghee symbolize devotion, sweet speech, and spiritual warmth.

menu_items.name: Curd Rice (Daddojanam)
menu_items.description: Cooling, velvety curd rice tempered with mustard seeds, curry leaves, ginger, and pomegranates.
menu_items.ingredients: Rice, Fresh Curd, Ginger, Mustard, Curry Leaves, Butter
menu_items.worship_significance: Offered as the final offering in daily temple rituals to grant peace of mind (Shanti) and physical cooling.

menu_items.name: Panakam
menu_items.description: Rejuvenating divine beverage made with pure jaggery water, black pepper, cardamom, and dry ginger.
menu_items.ingredients: Jaggery Water, Black Pepper, Dry Ginger, Cardamom, Lemon juice
menu_items.worship_significance: Offered on Sri Rama Navami and temple brahmotsavams as a divine elixir that purifies body and soul.

menu_items.name: Butter & Misri (Makhan)
menu_items.description: Fresh churned white butter served with rock sugar (Misri) and tulsi leaf.
menu_items.ingredients: Fresh White Cow Butter, Rock Sugar Candy, Holy Tulsi
menu_items.worship_significance: Beloved Naivedyam of Lord Krishna and Lord Vishnu representing childlike pure devotion.

menu_items.name: Samosa
menu_items.description: Crispy pastry triangle filled with spiced potatoes, green peas, cumin, and coriander seeds.
menu_items.ingredients: Wheat Pastry, Potatoes, Peas, Spices

menu_items.name: Onion Pakoda
menu_items.description: Golden crunchy fritters made with thinly sliced onions, gram flour batter, curry leaves, and green chilies.
menu_items.ingredients: Onions, Besan (Gram Flour), Rice Flour, Curry Leaves

menu_items.name: Mirchi Bajji
menu_items.description: Large Andhra green chilies stuffed with tangy tamarind spice, dipped in besan batter and fried crisp.
menu_items.ingredients: Green Chilies, Besan, Ajwain, Tamarind Spice

menu_items.name: Gulab Jamun
menu_items.description: Soft melt-in-mouth milk solid dumplings fried golden and soaked in cardamom rose sugar syrup.
menu_items.ingredients: Khoya, Paneer, Sugar Syrup, Rose Essence, Cardamom

menu_items.name: Rasmalai
menu_items.description: Flattened soft cottage cheese discs soaked in chilled saffron and cardamom infused milk garnished with pistachios.
menu_items.ingredients: Paneer Chhena, Thickened Milk, Saffron, Pistachio, Almonds

menu_items.name: Mysore Pak
menu_items.description: Melt in your mouth classic South Indian sweet made with gram flour, sugar, and generous pure desi ghee.
menu_items.ingredients: Gram Flour, Pure Cow Ghee, Sugar

menu_items.name: Filter Coffee
menu_items.description: Authentic South Indian Kumbakonam style decoction coffee brewed fresh and frothed with thick milk.
menu_items.ingredients: Coffee Decoction (80% Coffee 20% Chicory), Whole Milk, Sugar

menu_items.name: Buttermilk (Majjiga)
menu_items.description: Cooling churned spiced buttermilk blended with green chilies, ginger, curry leaves, crushed cumin, and coriander.
menu_items.ingredients: Curd Water, Ginger, Green Chili, Cumin, Mustard, Curry Leaves

menu_items.name: Badam Milk
menu_items.description: Rich warm/chilled milk flavored with crushed almonds, cardamom, saffron strands, and pistachios.
menu_items.ingredients: Full Cream Milk, Almond Paste, Saffron, Cardamom, Pistachio

reviews.comment: Authentic Tirupati taste! The ghee idlis were divine and soft as cotton.
The Srivari Maha Bhojanam is a royal feast! Laddu was heavenly.
The Tirupati Laddu prasadam has exact temple ghee aroma and taste. Blessed experience.
